This question tests practical disaster recovery planning skills, including cross-region replication strategies and cost control during outages. It evaluates how well candidates design for data gravity and service continuity across AWS services at enterprise scale.

## Key Concepts
- Cross-region disaster recovery with defined RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and RPO (Recovery Point Objective)

Strong answers should address the warm standby architecture, data replication strategy (S3 CRR for object storage, DynamoDB Global Tables for NoSQL state), failover automation (Route 53 weighted routing, Lambda/Step Functions), cost guardrails (right-sized standby resources, auto-scaling policies, shutdown schedules), and testing methodology (chaos engineering, regular DR drills, RTO/RPO validation). questions.explanation: This question tests real-world DR orchestration in multi-region data pipelines. Key corrections: Redshift has no native cross-region automated snapshots (unlike RDS)-use manual snapshots copied via AWS Backup or S3 cross-region replication for standby data. Redshift 'hot standby' is a misnomer-you restore from snapshot (minutes to hours depending on data size); true hot standby requires RA3 with cross-region read replicas. The architecture separates detection (CloudWatch/Glue DQ), orchestration (Step Functions), and execution (Lambda with cross-account STS AssumeRole). ## Code Example

```json
{
  "Comment": "DR failover workflow",
  "StartAt": "AssessAlarm",
  "States": {
    "AssessAlarm": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.alarm", "BooleanEquals": true, "Next": "PromoteFailover"}], "Default": "Wait"},
    "PromoteFailover": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:route53:changeResourceRecordSets", "Next": "RunCanary"},
    "RunCanary": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "Next": "Validate"},
    "Validate": {"Type": "Choice", "Choices": [{"Variable": "$.canaryOk", "BooleanEquals": true, "Next": "End"}], "Default": "Rollback"},
    "Rollback": {"Type": "Task", "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke", "End": true},
    "End": {"Type": "Succeed"}
  }
}
```
